title: Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers: Global Rule Isolation and Deterministic Sampling Manifold Compression
abstract: arXiv:2611.19009v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Role-Separated Diffusion Transformers (RoSeDiT), a new diffusion transformer architecture that isolates the global rule from the image tokens. RoSeViT showed in visual reasoning that a vanilla ViT spreads a shared rule over all $L$ tokens at an entropy of order $Ld$, whereas an enforced controller route reduces it to order $d$. In class-conditional DiT and SiT, the class and the noise level are explicitly conditioned by adaLN, so a RoSeViT-style controller channel on the ViT side is insufficient to establish the full role separation. By introducing the adaLN listening mechanism, which makes adaLN compute under the controller's command, RoSeDiT brings the entropy theorem and role separation into the latent diffusion domain. Under the same SiT training and evaluation protocol at the same level of parameter count, RoSeDiT surpasses SiT at all four model scales at 400K steps, and RoSeDiT-L/2 even surpasses SiT-XL/2's 17.2 FID wi

translated_title: 角色分离扩散Transformer：全局规则隔离与确定性采样流形压缩
translated_abstract: 我们提出了角色分离扩散Transformer（RoSeDiT），这是一种新的扩散Transformer架构，能够将全局规则与图像token分离开来。RoSeViT在视觉推理中已表明，原始ViT会将共享规则分散到全部L个token上，其熵为Ld量级，而强制的控制器路由则可将其降低至d量级。在类别条件化的DiT和SiT中，类别标签和噪声水平由adaLN显式地进行条件化，因此仅在ViT一侧设置RoSeViT式的控制器通道不足以建立完整的角色分离。通过引入adaLN监听机制——即让adaLN在控制器的指挥下进行计算——RoSeDiT将熵定理和角色分离带入了潜空间扩散领域。在相同的SiT训练与评估协议以及同等参数量条件下，RoSeDiT在400K训练步数时于全部四个模型规模上都超越了SiT，其中RoSeDiT-L/2甚至超过了SiT-XL/2的17.2 FID成绩……
tldr: RoSeDiT通过引入adaLN监听机制实现全局规则与图像token的完整角色分离，将熵定理引入潜空间扩散领域，在同等参数量和相同训练协议下于全部四个模型规模上超越SiT。
en_tdlr: RoSeDiT introduces an adaLN listening mechanism to fully separate the global rule from image tokens, bringing the entropy theorem into the latent diffusion domain and surpassing SiT across all four model scales under the same parameter count and training protocol.
